title: Lower Falls
place: Lower Falls of the Yellowstone River from Lookout Point, Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone, Yellowstone NP, Wyoming
notes: Single locked-off telephoto shot: Lower Falls pouring into a snowy canyon at golden hour, a huge glowing mist plume billowing up from the base the whole time. Source 1280x720 60p, upscaled to 1080p and resampled to 30 fps. Falls brink x~0.37, y~0.22; water column x~0.33-0.40; mist plume x~0.15-0.50, y 0.45-1.0. Best centre for a square crop: x~0.35 (a centred square would put the falls left of centre). All 14 s usable; mist billows most at 0-6 s and 10-14 s. Same shot continues through source 0-60 s if more is needed. No people, no text, no logos.
fact_en: The 308-foot (93.9-m) Lower Falls can be seen from Lookout Point, Red Rock Point, Artist Point... (NPS: 'The Upper Falls are 109 feet (33 m) and the Lower Falls are 308 feet (94 m).')
